intro: I travel to slow down, meet people, and notice what I would otherwise miss. A camera comes along. The best things I bring back are usually memories.

currently.Planning: A few days away from the familiar

destinations.description: Three days of mist, mountain roads, and quiet mornings.
destinations.headline: Some mornings are worth getting lost in.
destinations.introduction: We left before the town woke up. Somewhere along the climb, the road disappeared into a cloud.
story: There was no grand plan for the morning. Just a winding road, a flask of tea, and enough time to stop whenever the view asked us to.
By afternoon the mist had lifted. The hills looked completely different, but it was that first quiet hour that stayed with me.
destinations.details: Slow drives, short walks, tea stops. A light layer for the early mornings.
destinations.memory: For a few minutes, the mountains disappeared and the whole road belonged to the mist.

destinations.description: Salt in the air. Nowhere to be before sunset.
destinations.headline: We stayed until the sky ran out of color.
destinations.introduction: The afternoon was meant to be a short stop by the sea. It became the whole day.
story: We walked without checking the time, stopping for something cold and finding our way back to the water. The conversations moved at the same pace as the waves.
At sunset, everyone seemed to pause together. I took a few photographs, then put the camera away.
destinations.details: A coastal weekend with long walks and an unhurried evening. Carry water and leave room in the day for doing very little.
destinations.memory: We forgot what we were talking about when the sea turned pink.

destinations.description: Old streets, unexpected conversations, and the last blue light.
destinations.headline: A different story around every corner.
destinations.introduction: I went looking for a change of scene and found a reason to take the long way around.
story: The best part of the day was not a place on a list. It was a conversation outside a small shop, followed by a street I had almost walked past.
We stayed out as the lights came on. The city softened into blue, and familiar things started to look new.
destinations.details: A day on foot, a few café stops, and an evening by the water. Comfortable shoes matter more than a busy itinerary.
destinations.memory: A stranger's directions became the best detour of the day.
